# Arqing Renders

> Arqing Renders is a premium architectural visualization studio founded in 2011 and based in New York City, with 15+ years of experience creating photorealistic CGI stills, animations, and 360° virtual tours for architects, real estate developers, and investors. The studio has delivered 40+ projects across New York City and Jersey City, and over $1 billion in real estate has been visualized for pre-sales, financing, and entitlement approvals.

Arqing Renders (also referred to as "Arqing") serves architecture firms, real estate developers, and investors who need high-fidelity visuals to secure approvals, financing, and pre-sales. Core services: photorealistic CGI still renders, architectural animation/video, and 360° virtual tours. The studio covers all five boroughs of New York City plus the Jersey City waterfront, and works across residential, hospitality, and mixed-use typologies.

The site is bilingual: English is the primary/default version, with a complete Spanish twin under `/es/` (same structure, content, and imagery, translated copy).

## Facts

- Founded: 2011 (New York, NY, USA)
- Experience: 15+ years
- Projects delivered in NYC/Jersey City area: 40+
- Real estate value visualized: $1B+
- Coverage: Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, the Bronx, Staten Island, Jersey City waterfront
- Services: architectural CGI stills, architectural animation, 360° virtual tours
- Clients served: architecture firms, real estate developers, investors
- Languages: English (default), Spanish (/es/)
